verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say Functions can be triggered by "scheduled executions," so the platform has first-party scheduled job support, and its CLI and MCP server can create and deploy those Functions. However, the evidence never says schedules recur (for example cron expressions), and there is no multi-step workflow capability. Messaging's "schedule" feature only covers notification sends, so it is an adjacent feature. missing for 10: explicit evidence of recurring/cron scheduling, details on schedule configuration and limits, workflow orchestration beyond single functions, independent or hands-on corroboration
